recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast stage photograph featuring a male performer in silhouette, illuminated by a brilliant, starburst-style lens flare. The composition is dominated by a dark, textured background with a large-scale typographic header and a centered list of text elements.
coreVisualRelationships: The bright starburst flare acts as the primary light source and focal point against a deep black void.
The oversized, high-contrast serif typography at the top anchors the vertical composition.
The performer's silhouette provides a human element that balances the abstract light effect.
The centered list of text creates a formal, symmetrical column in the right half of the frame.
coreInvariants: A singular, multi-pointed white starburst lens flare.
Deep black background with subtle circular grain or texture.
High-contrast white-on-black color scheme with a single warm accent color.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Performer silhouette positioned on the far left, occupying approximately one-third of the width; large display text at the top right.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The intense white starburst flare located at the performer's chest level.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the bright flare to the large display text at the top, then down the centered list of text in the middle-right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive dark negative space surrounding the central text and performer, creating a sense of stage depth.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Pure white for the starburst and primary typography.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Muted coral or salmon pink used for secondary display text.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Extreme value contrast between the light source and the background; low saturation overall.

letterConstructionRules: Extreme contrast between thick and thin strokes.
Tight letter spacing for the main header.
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'A' characters in the main title are oversized and tightly kerned to overlap slightly.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast serif for impact paired with a clean, legible sans-serif for information.
graphicDevices: Vertical text orientation for secondary display name.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the extreme contrast and sharp serifs of the display text.
Appropriate for the clean, vertical list of text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a dark, grainy stage background. On the left, a silhouette of a man in a suit gesturing. In the center-left, a brilliant white starburst lens flare with long, sharp rays. The floor should be a slightly lighter blue-grey stage surface.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large white Didone serif text at the top right. Place a smaller vertical name in coral pink to the left of the main header. Center a list of song titles in a light sans-serif font in the middle-right area.

verificationChecks: Is the starburst flare the brightest point in the image?
Is the display text high-contrast serif?
Is the background sufficiently dark and textured?

adjustableVariables: Intensity and number of rays in the starburst
Specific shade of the accent coral color
postGenerationChecks: Check that the text is perfectly centered in its column.
Ensure the starburst does not blow out the silhouette details too much.
Verify the coral accent color is distinct but not neon.
Confirm the serif font has razor-thin hairlines.
recipe.reuseFormula: Dramatic Stage Silhouette + Starburst Flare + High-Contrast Didone Header + Centered List
